newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA TOIL AGAINST SOUTH AFRICAN ATTACK.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA TOIL AGAINST SOUTH AFRICAN ATTACK.

text.p: A tigerish display of fielding and bowling by South Africa restricted India to 179 for nine in their one day match on Sunday.

A 105-run fourth wicket partnership between Mohammad Azharuddin (57) and Rahul Dravid (50) in 30 overs rescued an innings in danger of disintegration from the moment Adam Bacher had alertly run out Saurav Ganguly in the first over.

Javagal Srinath was caught behind three overs later and Sachin Tendulkar was bowled through the gate by Allan Donald for a single to bring the fourth wicket pair together at 11 for three in the eighth over.

Azharuddin and Dravid put on the first 50 in a patient 117 balls but were accelerating -- their second 50 came in 57 balls -- when Donald returned for a second spell to dismiss them both in three balls.
India's total was the first in 11 innings of the triangular series not to have reached 200 runs.
